urgency.name: Urgency
urgency.instructions: How urgent and time-sensitive is the tone of this text?

formality.name: Formality
formality.instructions: How formal is the tone of this text?

friendliness.name: Friendliness
friendliness.instructions: How friendly and warm is the tone of this text?

specificity.name: Specificity
specificity.instructions: How specific and concrete is this text?
criteria: Entirely vague with no concrete detail

confidence.name: Confidence
confidence.instructions: How confident and certain is the tone of this text?

emotion.name: Emotion
emotion.instructions: How emotionally intense is the tone of this text?

professionalism.name: Professionalism
professionalism.instructions: How professional, appropriate, and work-ready is the tone of this text?
criteria: Careless or inappropriate for a workplace

playfulness.name: Playfulness
playfulness.instructions: How playful or humorous is the tone of this text?

directness.name: Directness
directness.instructions: How direct and explicit is the tone of this text?
criteria: Highly indirect and reliant on implication
A balanced mix of suggestion and directness
Completely explicit and straight to the point

politeness.name: Politeness
politeness.instructions: How polite and courteous is the tone of this text?

optimism.name: Optimism
optimism.instructions: How optimistic is the outlook expressed by this text?
criteria: Balanced or emotionally neutral in outlook
Extremely optimistic and confident of a good outcome

sincerity.name: Sincerity
sincerity.instructions: How genuine and sincere is the tone of this text?
criteria: Mostly insincere or difficult to believe
Ambiguous or neutral in apparent sincerity

assertiveness.name: Assertiveness
assertiveness.instructions: How clearly and firmly does this text state a request, need, decision, or boundary?
criteria: Avoids expressing any request, need, decision, or boundary
States a position hesitantly or apologetically
States a position with moderate firmness
Clearly and firmly states what is wanted or decided
Unambiguously states a strong demand or boundary

empathy.name: Empathy
empathy.instructions: How empathetic and attentive to another person's feelings is this text?
criteria: Dismissive or entirely detached from others' feelings
Acknowledges another perspective without much warmth

diplomacy.name: Diplomacy
diplomacy.instructions: How tactfully does this text handle disagreement, criticism, or a sensitive subject?
criteria: Highly insensitive or inflammatory about the disagreement
Shows little tact or awareness of sensitivities
Handles the subject in a neutral, measured way
Clearly tactful and considerate of different positions
Exceptionally diplomatic and careful to preserve the relationship

humility.name: Humility
humility.instructions: How humble rather than boastful is the tone of this text?
criteria: Balanced without clear boasting or humility

caution.name: Caution
caution.instructions: How cautious and risk-aware is the tone of this text?
criteria: Reckless with no concern for risk
Shows little caution or risk awareness
Clearly cautious and attentive to risk

cooperation.name: Cooperation
cooperation.instructions: How willing is the speaker to coordinate, compromise, or work toward a shared outcome?
criteria: Refuses cooperation or deliberately obstructs shared work
Open to working together if needed
Actively coordinates and supports shared work
Strongly seeks compromise and shared success

violence.name: Violence
violence.instructions: How much does this text threaten, describe, or encourage physical harm?
criteria: No threat, description, or encouragement of physical harm
A mild reference to physical force or harm
Implied physical harm or a clear depiction of violence
An explicit physical threat or serious violent act
Graphic, extreme, or repeated physical violence

whimsy.name: Whimsy
whimsy.instructions: How whimsical, fanciful, or imaginatively unusual is this text?
criteria: A slight imaginative or fanciful touch

sarcasm.name: Sarcasm
sarcasm.instructions: How sarcastic is the tone of this text, using irony, mock praise, or saying the opposite of what is meant?
criteria: Entirely literal and earnest with no sarcasm
A faint dry or ironic edge
Clearly sarcastic, with the intended meaning contrasting the wording
Relentlessly cutting sarcasm where the wording emphatically means its opposite

panic.name: Panic
panic.instructions: How panicked, alarmed, or overwhelmed is the tone of this text?
criteria: Strongly panicked and struggling to stay composed

passive_aggression.name: Passive aggression
passive_aggression.instructions: How passive-aggressive is the tone of this text?
criteria: Entirely straightforward with no concealed hostility
A faint edge or indirect irritation
Noticeably indirect criticism behind polite wording
Strong passive aggression with pointed courtesy
Extreme passive aggression where every polite phrase carries hostility

smugness.name: Smugness
smugness.instructions: How smug or self-satisfied is the tone of this text?

drama.name: Drama
drama.instructions: How melodramatic or theatrically heightened is the tone of this text?
criteria: Highly melodramatic with grand emotional stakes
Maximum season-finale drama where everything feels momentous

ominousness.name: Ominousness
ominousness.instructions: How ominous, foreboding, or suggestive of impending trouble is this text?
criteria: A faint suggestion that something may be wrong
Extremely ominous, as if disaster is unavoidable and near
